title: Guard the database — a lifecycle hook policy for Harbourline
feature: Devin lifecycle hooks: .devin/hooks.v1.json with PreToolUse (exit 0 / exit 2, updatedInput), PostToolUse and Stop, matcher as regex or list
prerequisites: Repo cloned locally, `pnpm install` done at the root, Node 22
PostgreSQL up with `pnpm db:up` and seeded with `pnpm db:seed -- --reset` (only needed to see the read-only wrapper reject a write for real)
Lab 00 done once, so you know how the voice coach works
Work on a throwaway branch such as `lab/02-<your-handle>`; never commit hooks to `main`

matrix.integration: Devin CLI (hooks are loaded from .devin/hooks.v1.json; /hooks lists them)
matrix.fixture: Offline replay: `node labs/02-lifecycle-hooks/solution/simulate.mjs --config .devin/hooks.v1.json --event PreToolUse --tool exec --command '<shell command>'` feeds one event to your hooks with the documented stdin/exit-code contract
matrix.note: With the CLI you also see the agent's reaction to a block; the replay only shows the decision

matrix.integration: Devin web app (Agent mode) for the voice coach in section 8
matrix.fixture: Run the drill against a timer and self-score with the rubric in the answer
matrix.note: Coaching is always started by you; nothing is scheduled

matrix.fixture: Skip the live write test; the replay still shows the psql rewrite
matrix.note: Only the lab database at localhost:5432/harbourline is ever touched

credentials.fixture_only_story: Everything except the agent's own reaction works offline: you write .devin/hooks.v1.json and the hook scripts, then replay each acceptance case through simulate.mjs and keep its JSON output and the audit log as evidence. The replay labels the two behaviours the docs do not state (timeout and malformed config) as assumptions; with the Devin CLI you confirm them yourself.
not_exercised: Whether cloud (web app) sessions honour .devin/hooks.v1.json — the hooks docs describe the Devin CLI
Timeout and malformed-config behaviour of the real CLI — not stated in the docs; the replay assumes fail-open and says so

scenarios.clean_state: `.devin/hooks.v1.json` is `{}`, `git status --short` shows nothing under `db/` or `.devin/`, `scenarios/bad-migration.patch` is not applied (no `db/migrations/*currency-nullable*.sql`), and `pnpm db:seed -- --reset` has just rebuilt the seed dataset in the lab database.

injectors.name: bad-migration
injectors.when: T+30 min, once your PreToolUse hook exists
injectors.behaviour: The patch `scenarios/bad-migration.patch` lands on your branch and someone wants it applied and migrated. It drops the NOT NULL default on orders.currency; your policy must stop it before anything reaches the database and leave a reason Devin can read.

injectors.name: malformed-hooks
injectors.behaviour: Copy `labs/02-lifecycle-hooks/injectors/malformed-hooks.v1.json` over `.devin/hooks.v1.json` (it has a trailing comma and a missing brace). Find out what your guard does now and decide whether the policy fails open or closed.

injectors.name: slow-hook
injectors.behaviour: Copy `labs/02-lifecycle-hooks/injectors/slow-hook.v1.json` into place: a hook that sleeps 15 s against a 3 s timeout and would block if it ever finished. Observe whether the tool call is blocked, delayed or allowed.

injectors.name: matcher-glob
injectors.behaviour: Copy `labs/02-lifecycle-hooks/injectors/matcher-glob.v1.json` into place. A colleague wrote the matcher the way they write permission globs. Check which tool calls it still guards.
